pharmaceutical_form: solution for injection in pre-filled syringe
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || dissolve in water
single_dose: adults 600 mg (two 300 mg injections) followed by 300 mg every other week
adolescents (12 years of age and older) 400 mg (two 200 mg injections) followed by 200 mg every other week
children 6 to less than 30 kg 600 mg (two 300 mg injections) 300 mg every 4 weeks (Q4W)
children 30 to less than 60 kg 400 mg (two 200 mg injections) 200 mg every other week (Q2W)
children 60 kg or more 600 mg (two 300 mg injections) 300 mg every other week (Q2W)
mechanism_of_action: targets a type of protein called an interleukin, that is involved in inflammation. Dupixent calms an overreactive immune system but it does not suppress the immune system.
side_effects: eye pain or discomfort || watery eyes (your eyes may be more sensitive to light) || pain, swelling, burning, or irritation where an injection was given. || eye redness or itching, puffy eyelids || sleep problems (insomnia). || cold sores or fever blisters on your lips or in your mouth.
